purpose: Independent private learning replication of the NeurIPS 2024 experiment design; no course submission or student originality claim
paper: Zhang, Zou, Cao, The Implicit Bias of Adam on Separable Data, NeurIPS 2024, final conference PDF, sections 3 and 5
initialization: independent PCG64(seed+10000) standard_normal(d), shared across methods on each data set
selection: maximum Euclidean distance between the L2-unit-normalized L2 and Linfinity reference directions; ties go to smallest seed
arithmetic: Common positive exponential rescaling of Adam moments, algebraically the same recurrence in real arithmetic, independently compared with literal float64 Adam before underflow; no epsilon/clamp added
rules: Freeze before primary results; retain all ten data sets and all primary method outcomes
Selection depends only on convex reference geometry, never on observed optimizer performance
Pilot, full primary runs, rate sweep, and epsilon extension use separate new output paths
Preserve explicit budget or numerical failures and all recorded checkpoints
Raw trajectories means observed optimizer checkpoints, not theoretical or interpolated values
Finite threshold is a team descriptive criterion, not a paper theorem or proof of convergence
